meta.subject: fixed shared memory addressing critical path, fixed VX_fp_noncomp output bug

en.summary: This is a mixed but real DUT bug-fix commit. It repairs shared-memory address-range decoding and, more clearly, fixes VX_fp_noncomp so valid/tag metadata are pipelined alongside the delayed FP result instead of being emitted one stage early.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly names an output bug in VX_fp_noncomp.
The patch changes core DUT logic in both the memory unit and an FP execution block.
The FP hunk directly aligns valid/tag metadata with the computation pipeline, which is a correctness fix rather than a refactor.
disqualifiers: The commit contains two separate fixes, so one reinjection target must be chosen as primary.
Several other touched files in the full commit are only minor plumbing or register-name cleanup.
evidence: hw/rtl/fp_cores/VX_fp_noncomp.v adds valid_in_r and tag_in_r and sends them through pipe_reg1 before pipe_reg2 consumes them.
The final output register in VX_fp_noncomp.v changed from {valid_in, tag_in, ...} to {valid_in_r, tag_in_r, ...}.
hw/rtl/VX_mem_unit.v also changes shared-memory selection from a subtraction-based comparison to an explicit bounded address-range check.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a pipelined execution unit, result data and the metadata that identifies the destination operation must traverse the same number of stages. If valid bits, destination tags, warp IDs, or similar metadata stay on a shorter path than the result itself, the unit can emit a correct numeric result with the wrong identity attached. That causes silent cross-instruction corruption even when the arithmetic datapath is correct.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An execution unit adds at least one internal pipeline stage to the data path of an operation, but the outgoing valid/tag metadata are still sourced from an earlier stage.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drive the output register with current-cycle valid/tag metadata instead of the same-stage delayed metadata that matches the result.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: desynchronize metadata pipeline from data pipeline
portability_notes: This maps to FP, integer, vector, or any other pipelined execution block that returns both data and destination metadata.
If the target DUT has no explicit tag signal, use the equivalent metadata such as reorder-buffer entry, destination register index, lane mask, or warp ID.
The shared-memory address-range fix in the same commit is real, but the FP metadata-alignment bug is the cleaner reusable injection.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify a pipelined execution unit where data are delayed by an extra stage before response emission.
Leave the result datapath latency unchanged, but source the outgoing valid/tag or destination metadata from the pre-delay stage.
Keep backpressure behavior intact so the mismatch is observed at the normal response boundary.
Run at least two different in-flight operations so a result can be attributed to the wrong consumer.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds valid_in_r and tag_in_r to pipe_reg1 and then feeds pipe_reg2 with the delayed metadata instead of the original valid_in and tag_in signals.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_fp_noncomp.v, pipe_reg1 was widened to include valid/tag, and pipe_reg2 input changed from {valid_in, tag_in, ...} to {valid_in_r, tag_in_r, ...}.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The execution unit can return an FP non-compute result with the wrong valid/tag metadata, causing the wrong destination, warp, or instruction context to consume the result.
evidence_for_injection: The computation inputs dataa/datab and control op_type/frm are already delayed through pipe_reg1, but valid/tag were not delayed before this fix.
The final output register is exactly where result payload and metadata are reunited, making it the precise reinjection point.
The commit message explicitly identifies VX_fp_noncomp output behavior as buggy.
notes: The shared-memory address comparator in VX_mem_unit.v is also a real fix in this commit, but it is a separate bug.
For a smaller and more portable dataset mutation, use the FP metadata-alignment bug as the primary reinjection target.

zh.summary: 这是一个混合但真实的 DUT bug-fix 提交。它同时修复了 shared memory 地址范围译码，以及更清晰的 VX_fp_noncomp 输出错误：valid/tag 元数据现在会和延迟后的 FP 结果一起流水，而不是提前一个阶段输出。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确点名了 VX_fp_noncomp 的输出 bug。
补丁修改了 memory unit 和 FP 执行模块中的核心 DUT 逻辑。
FP hunk 直接把 valid/tag 元数据与计算流水对齐，这是正确性修复而不是重构。
disqualifiers: 该提交同时包含两个独立修复，因此需要为故障回注选定一个主目标。
完整提交中其他若干被修改文件只是轻量接线或寄存器名称清理。
evidence: hw/rtl/fp_cores/VX_fp_noncomp.v 新增了 valid_in_r 和 tag_in_r，并让它们通过 pipe_reg1 进入 pipe_reg2。
VX_fp_noncomp.v 中最终输出寄存器从 {valid_in, tag_in, ...} 改成了 {valid_in_r, tag_in_r, ...}。
hw/rtl/VX_mem_unit.v 也把 shared memory 选择条件从减法比较改成了显式的有界地址范围判断。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在流水化执行单元中，结果数据与标识其目标操作的元数据必须经过相同数量的流水级。如果 valid 位、目标 tag、warp ID 或类似元数据走的是更短路径，而结果本身多经过了一级，那么该单元就可能输出数值正确但归属错误的结果。即使算术数据通路完全正确，这也会造成静默的跨指令污染。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 执行流水中的元数据对齐
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个执行单元的数据路径多经过至少一级流水，但输出使用的 valid/tag 元数据仍来自更早一级。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让输出寄存器继续使用当前周期的 valid/tag 元数据，而不是使用与结果同级延迟后的元数据。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 让元数据流水与结果流水失配
portability_notes: 可映射到 FP、整数、向量或其他任何同时返回数据和目标元数据的流水执行模块。
如果目标 DUT 没有显式 tag，可使用等价元数据，例如 ROB 项、目的寄存器号、lane mask 或 warp ID。
同一提交中的 shared memory 地址范围修复也是真实 bug，但 FP 元数据对齐错误更适合作为可复用注入点。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到一个结果数据在输出前多延迟一级的流水执行模块。
保持结果数据路径延迟不变，但让输出 valid/tag 或目标元数据继续取自未延迟的前一级。
保持背压行为不变，使错误在正常的响应边界上暴露出来。
运行至少两个不同的在途操作，使某次结果有机会被错误地归属于另一个消费者。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_fp_noncomp 输出流水中的元数据对齐逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 valid_in_r 和 tag_in_r 加入 pipe_reg1，并让 pipe_reg2 使用延迟后的元数据，而不是继续使用原始的 valid_in 和 tag_in。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_fp_noncomp.v 中，pipe_reg1 被扩展为包含 valid/tag，pipe_reg2 的输入也从 {valid_in, tag_in, ...} 改为 {valid_in_r, tag_in_r, ...}。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 执行单元可能输出带有错误 valid/tag 元数据的 FP 非比较类结果，导致错误的目标、warp 或指令上下文接收该结果。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，dataa/datab 和 op_type/frm 已经通过 pipe_reg1 延迟，但 valid/tag 没有一起延迟。
最终输出寄存器正是结果负载与元数据重新汇合的位置，因此这里是最精确的回注点。
提交信息明确指出 VX_fp_noncomp 的输出行为存在 bug。
notes: VX_mem_unit.v 中的 shared-memory 地址比较器也是该提交修复的一部分，但它属于另一个独立 bug。
为了得到更小、更可移植的故障样本，建议以 FP 元数据对齐错误作为主注入目标。
